profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineering team lead specializing in front-end development for web applications in marketing cloud services and healthcare. With eleven years of full stack expertise.

My journey has been shaped by overcoming the challenges of a first generation college student. Through hard work, determination, and the guidance of amazing mentors, I achieved my dream to graduate from MIT. This instilled in me a deep appreciation for the value of education and the importance of helping break barriers.

As a proponent for user-centered design, I advocate for solutions that prioritize the needs and experiences of users. I firmly believe in the power of collaboration and the inclusion of diverse perspectives to drive innovation. Having worked in global and remote-only environments, I excel at fostering trust and open communication in cross-functional teams.

Additionally, I am a strong advocate for thorough and scalable systems documentation. I understand the critical role it plays in ensuring alignment, smooth knowledge transfer, and long-term sustainability of projects. 

Outside of work I find joy in connecting with others. On weekends you'll likely find me exploring serene waters on a kayak with my partner, honing my Spanish language skills, unwinding with video games, or dedicating my time to volunteering for education and mental health related causes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Orchestrated product delivery lifecycle and facilitated cross-functional stakeholder communication for projects across the business as a Team Lead

• Spearheaded initiatives from concept to delivery as a product and web engineering domain expert for pharmacist and patient applications

• Led the technical aspects of pharmacist product redesign and numerous 3rd party technical, product, and business integrations

• Streamlined React applications by eliminating complex redux dependencies, integrating them with the UX design language, upgrading legacy React, JavaScript, and web code/conventions, and breaking down monolithic files into smaller, shareable, component-based code

• Proactively acquired and shared extensive knowledge in backend, database, data metrics, business, and operations domains

• Pioneered front-end team sync-ups to foster knowledge sharing, discuss tech innovations, align on best practices, and mitigate information silos

• Developed and guided the team in creating concise technical design specifications, comprehensive manual test plans, effective unit tests, and rigorous code reviews

• Championed interviewing, onboarding, coaching and mentoring new hires; grew team from 6 to 20

• Cultivated a collaborative, productive, and empathetic team environment

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: HTML · Agile Methodologies · Webpack · Front-End Development · Jira · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Security point of contact for client applications org-wide; Triaged issues and led efforts for compliance and testing

• Provided engineering expertise in a cross-disciplinary global Agile Scrum team

• Contributed to a large framework and core application for a cloud-based email and mobile marketing platform

• Led migration of new JS framework and first team adoption of internal low-code application builder 

• Mentored and trained junior UI developers in code standards, application knowledge, and UI development

• Innovated on application usability by driving the use of animation and UI microinteraction

• Organized and participated in two internal hackathons

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: • Upgraded JavaScript frameworks for applications from Ext JS 3 & 4.2 to Ext JS 6

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Created a social media website using Twitter API, resulted in reduced outsourcing costs 
• Analyzed and documented the efficacy of a proof-of-concept algorithm central to an application
• Designed and analyzed a relational database schema for an extensive set of user health data
• Regularly presented technical material to a multidisciplinary leadership team
• Software Development, System Testing, and Evaluation within Agile Scrum Teams

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Designed, programmed and tested a lightweight web framework employing Ruby and Sinatra
• Implemented a new system to identify active products, saving in immediate maintenance costs 
• Reviewed and contributed to design decisions of a program for use in a larger software framework
• Increased the performance speed of existing database queries
• Coordinated with a team using Github and proprietary version control

positions.title: Software Systems Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a new software script that was used company-wide to troubleshoot network issues
• Evaluated various design decisions, implemented in Perl employing open-source libraries 
• Reduced the average Quality Assurance troubleshooting calls related to networking
